visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A toddler girl with dark hair tied in two pigtails and blunt bangs is sitting on a light-colored wooden floor in a brightly lit indoor living room. She wears a white sleeveless romper with pink floral patterns. An adult's hand briefly enters the frame, pointing a finger towards a wooden toy makeup compact the girl is holding. In the background, a large white beanbag chair and a toy kitchen set are visible under soft, natural daylight. (2) The toddler holds a white circular wooden puff and dabs it against the wooden compact. She looks down with intense concentration, then brings the puff to her left cheek, gently patting her face. Her facial expression remains calm and focused on the task. A yellow toy duck-like object lies on the floor nearby. (3) The girl picks up a light green and wooden hair straightener toy. She uses both hands to press the toy against her bangs, mimicking the action of styling her hair. The camera maintains a medium close-up shot, capturing her delicate hand movements and facial features as she looks slightly off-camera. (4) She puts down the straightener and picks up a wooden toy hair dryer, pointing the nozzle towards the side of her head. During this phase, another child's legs in denim shorts are seen walking across the background from right to left. The toddler continues her pretend play, glancing toward the adult observer. (5) The girl returns to the wooden compact and powder puff. She dabs the puff on her cheek once more, then looks down to manipulate the toy set. The editing uses straight cuts to show her progression through different makeup and hair styling steps. (6) The video transitions to an end-credit screen with a solid pink background. A cartoon illustration of the same toddler girl appears in the center, and text overlays are displayed below the graphic.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) An adult female voice speaks with a friendly, high-pitched maternal tone in Mandarin, introducing the 'powder puff'. A sequence of rhythmic wooden tapping sounds ensues, mimicking the application of makeup. The child emits a high-pitched, energetic exclamation 'Wow!'. The adult praises her beauty, followed by a loud, sharp wooden clack SFX. (3) The dialogue continues as the child states she is finished. The adult asks to see her face. The child politely requests the hair clip toy. Several distinct wooden impact sounds occur as the toys are picked up and put down. The music maintains a happy major-key mood. (4) The mother suggests blow-drying hair. The child responds in a soft, slightly hesitant voice saying she isn't done. Two resonant wooden clacks are heard. The background guitar continues its cheerful, upbeat pattern without interruption or volume shifts. (5) The adult checks if the child is finished with the makeup process. The child says 'Not yet' in a soft timbre. A final series of percussive wooden taps occurs. The track concludes with the child saying 'Okay' as the music reaches a final chord and fades.
